questions: Check companion resolution, no-plan receipts, escalation and reuse of the shared resource map.
Preserve fast DIRECT checks and measure observer activation costs for long validations.
decision: Keep validate-or-fix as a lightweight companion using shared monitoring primitives, with no plan creation and explicit repair acceptance.
code_observations: validatectl has a guarded standalone validation path, receipts, classification and repair-route selection. The companion skill resolves the shared implementation rather than duplicating all runner logic.
DIRECT can opt into monitored validation without creating a plan, but must still preserve the user's fast path for short deterministic checks.
implementation_steps: Use a small trigger contract: plain build/lint/unit checks run directly; long, stateful or repeatedly ambiguous checks can request mapped monitoring without a TODO plan.
Pin standalone receipts to command, map and relevant source state, and give every runtime artifact an owned location outside product files.
Keep monitoring deterministic until an eligible ambiguity event; elapsed time alone does not force a paid observer.
Separate repair proposal, authorized edit execution and independent deterministic validation. The observer cannot approve its own repair.
Test companion discovery, missing/mismatched shared version and installation/uninstall boundaries. Fail clearly rather than importing a random similarly named module.
proposed_acceptance_tests: A short passing command leaves no manifest, TODO or orchestration directory.
A long mapped validation records progress and can diagnose a stall without creating a plan.
A successful old receipt is rejected after source or command changes.
A missing companion/shared implementation produces an actionable version error.
A failed repair never overwrites a successful receipt or claims completion from a model narrative.

alternatives.title: Require a full plan just to monitor tests
alternatives.tradeoff: Reuses orchestration but imposes unnecessary artifacts and tokens on cohesive work.

alternatives.title: Shared deterministic monitor with standalone receipts
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves fast DIRECT and avoids duplicating process/log logic.

alternatives.title: Fork the monitor into a second independent implementation
alternatives.tradeoff: Creates drift in cancellation, redaction and acceptance behavior.

cost_model: Measure startup/files created, observed CPU/I/O overhead, model calls and validated repair outcomes. Monitoring should earn its cost; do not universally enable it for every tiny test.
unverified: Actual user service maps and real repair-model execution remain untested. The task must retain explicit permission requirements.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
